name: POEMMA
summary: A space-mission concept would observe air showers from above with paired satellites, combining cosmic-ray fluorescence and neutrino-induced Cherenkov measurements.
physics_targets: Transient cosmic neutrinos above approximately 20 PeV
detection_principle: Two wide-field telescopes in loose formation would image ultraviolet fluorescence from cosmic-ray air showers and fast Cherenkov flashes near the Earth’s limb from tau-neutrino-induced showers.

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: NASA’s April 2026 event explicitly discusses POEMMA as a mission concept.

timeline.event: NASA-funded probe-class concept and design studies.
NASA community meeting retained POEMMA among mission concepts.

collaboration.name: POEMMA Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Baseline mission
key_parameters.value: Two identical satellites in loose formation

key_parameters.name: Main optics
key_parameters.value: Approximately 3.3 m entrance aperture, wide-field Schmidt design

key_parameters.name: Observation modes
key_parameters.value: Stereo fluorescence and Earth-limb Cherenkov imaging

results.summary: Science reach is calculated for a proposed mission; POEMMA has not produced a space-based neutrino detection.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
